title: August and the Gravity
author: Rosalind Fairweather
blurb: Felix Crane, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the fleet's truce expires.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
